age.evidence: Forty-nine male C57BL/6J mice (Jackson Laboratories, Bar Harbor, ME) aged between 10 and 12 weeks were used.

dosing.doses_raw: 0.3, 1, and 3 mg/kg (acute); 0.1 and 1 mg/kg once daily for 7 days (repeated)
dosing.evidence: Psilocybin ... dissolved in 0.9% saline solution ... administered subcutaneously 10 min prior to testing ... injections of psilocybin (0, 0.3, 1, and 3 mg/kg) ... injected once daily with assigned doses of psilocybin, for a total of 7 injections.
TCB-2 ... dissolved in 0.9% saline solution ... administered interperitoneally 15 min prior to testing.
M100907 ... dissolved in a 0.9% saline solution containing 0.3% tween ... administered subcutaneously ... 30 min prior to testing.

group_housing.evidence: Mice were group-housed in temperature- and humidity-controlled colony rooms

day_night_flipped.evidence: under a 12-h light-dark cycle (lights off at 7 pm)

assays.assay_description: Touchscreen operant task where mice discriminate visual target (S+) from non-target (S-) stimuli for milkshake reward. Tested under baseline (2-s SD), variable SD (1/0.75/0.5/0.25 s), and reduced SD (1 s) conditions following acute and repeated drug administration. Sessions max 45 min or until 100 rewards.

application_type.evidence: Psilocybin and M100907 were administered subcutaneously ... TCB-2 was administered interperitoneally

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were first habituated to the touchscreen chambers in a single 20-min session

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice freely moved in chamber to make nose-poke and touch responses

food_restriction.evidence: Mice undergoing touchscreen training were food restricted to 85-90% of their free-feeding body weight using a 3 h/day limited-access schedule.

time_to_assay.evidence: Psilocybin and M100907 were administered subcutaneously 10 and 30 min prior to testing, respectively. TCB-2 was administered interperitoneally 15 min prior to testing.

sample_size.evidence: Thirty-one mice were trained for experiments involving the CPT ... psilocybin (n = 11), TCB-2 (n = 10), or M100907 (n = 10).

outcomes.summary: Acute high-dose psilocybin (3 mg/kg), TCB-2 (3 mg/kg), and M100907 (0.3-1 mg/kg) reduced hit rate and false alarm rate and induced more conservative responding; psilocybin also reduced d' and increased latencies. No drug effects were observed in the variable-stimulus-duration CPT or following repeated psilocybin injections. Effects coincided with doses that reduced locomotor activity.
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin reduced hit rate ... false alarm rate ... and d' ... These effects were seen at the highest dose of 3 mg/kg. No drug effects were seen on the more difficult CPT or following repeated PSI injections.

B1_num_measures.evidence: hit rate, false alarm rate, d', response criterion c, response latency, reward collection latency

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Performance summarized per session; no within-session time-course analysis reported.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural transitions or sequences reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Operant touchscreen responses, not natural ethological behaviours.

B6_cognitive.evidence: In the CPT, mice learned to distinguish visual targets from non-targets for milkshake reward.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: The chambers were controlled using ABET II touchscreen software.

E2_shelter.evidence: No enclosed refuge in the operant chamber.

E4_nesting.evidence: No nesting material in testing apparatus.

E5_enrichment.evidence: Only touchscreen and reward tray; no enrichment objects.

E6_spatial.evidence: Single chamber with three response windows on one wall; no separate compartments.

E8_food_water.evidence: A peristaltic liquid pump ... delivered strawberry milkshake ... into a reward-tray.

D1_continuity.evidence: Drug testing sessions always took place on Tuesdays and Fridays ... Mice were then tested twice on the modified CPT ... tested for a third time ... off-drug.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Mice were tested for a maximum of 45 min, or until 100 rewards were achieved.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Multiple drug test days across experiments 1-3 on Tuesdays and Fridays plus repeated dosing test days.

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug baseline CPT trial was reported as a recording session; vehicle control was used.

D5_followup.evidence: Mice completed this last test off-drug following a 72-h drug washout period.

assays.assay_description: Spontaneous locomotor activity measured in eight Med Associates activity monitor chambers (40 x 40 x 35 cm) with 16x16 infrared photocell array. Distance travelled and ambulatory counts recorded for 60 min after injection, analyzed in 5-min bins.

application_type.evidence: Psilocybin and M100907 s.c.; TCB-2 i.p.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were habituated to testing chambers in two 1-h sessions.

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were injected ... and then immediately placed in the activity cages.

food_restriction.evidence: Separate cohort; no food in activity chambers during the 1-h recording.

water_restriction.evidence: No water bottle in activity chambers during recording.

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice were injected ... and then immediately placed in the activity cages.

sample_size.evidence: Eighteen mice from a separate cohort were used for locomotor tests. They were assigned into three equal groups (n = 6).

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (3 mg/kg) and TCB-2 (3 mg/kg) significantly reduced locomotor activity over the 1-h session compared to saline. All three doses of M100907 (0.1, 0.3, 1 mg/kg) significantly reduced distance travelled.
outcomes.evidence: Post hoc analysis showed that the 3 mg/kg dose of psilocybin significantly reduced locomotor activity compared to saline control ... All three doses of M100907 significantly reduced the distance that mice traveled when compared to saline control.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Ambulatory counts and measures of distance travelled were then recorded.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The right-hand panels show locomotor activity in 5-min bins across the test session.

B4_ethological.evidence: Locomotor distance via beam-breaks; not an ethological behaviour per rubric.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Spontaneous locomotor activity; no learning component.

E1_environment_type.evidence: activity monitor chambers (Med Associates) measuring 40 × 40 × 35 cm

E3_bedding.evidence: Standard Med Associates chambers; bedding not mentioned.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in activity chambers during the test.

D1_continuity.evidence: Locomotor activity was assessed for an hour after drug administration procedures.

D2_session_duration.evidence: recorded for a duration comprised of pre-treatment time + 60 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Repeated measures design with 4 dose conditions per drug; drug testing sessions separated by 72-h washout, on Tuesdays and Fridays.

D4_baseline.evidence: Habituation sessions not reported as analyzed baseline data.

D5_followup.evidence: No post-acute (>=24 h) locomotor recordings reported.

judge_notes: All three candidates agreed on 2 assays: CPT (collapsing baseline, variable-SD, and repeated-dosing variants into one paradigm per the rubric's 'different stimulus parameters' and 'acute vs. repeated dosing' rules) and Locomotor Activity. Adopted this consolidation.
Food restriction for CPT: gptoss said 'no' but the paper explicitly states mice were food-restricted to 85-90% body weight prior to/during training. Used 'before' per qwen/glm.
Water restriction for CPT: water available ad libitum in home cage; test apparatus has milkshake reward not water bottle, so used 'no' per paper's explicit ad libitum statement.

D3 (recording days) for CPT: candidates split 2-7 vs 8-14. Given Experiment 1 (4 doses x 3 drug groups, dose order Latin square on Tues/Fri) + Experiment 2 (3 doses) + Experiment 3 (3 test days), individual mice were tested on the CPT on ~8-12 distinct days. Chose 8-14.

D4 baseline for CPT: training is not 'pre-drug baseline recording' per the rubric (no pre-drug recording on same assay/environment with reported data used for drug comparison beyond vehicle control). Scored 0.
psychedelic field: included all three drugs (psilocybin + TCB-2 + M100907) since TCB-2 is a 5-HT2A agonist and the paper frames all three as the manipulation of interest.
